fewFlagsRaiser.why: It raises risk strongly only for rural men (15.4 logits non-smoking, 12.1 smoking) and by about 3 for urban men and rural women, so 'at most one flag' is an envelope; the real reading is 'rural man', which the text gives but the headline does not.

smokerOrRuralLowerer.why: It lowers risk for rural people and male smokers and decides the two-flag smoker groups, but is nearly off for urban female smokers, so 'lowers the risk of smokers' holds only for part of its stated population.

urbanNonSmokingWomanLowerer.why: It is the only lowerer acting on non-smoking urban women, and switching it off flips all 4963 of their predictions; elsewhere it is small as stated.

smokerOrFemaleRaiser.why: It raises risk for smokers and women, most for female smokers, grows with age in every probe, and keeps urban female smokers high risk (1026 of 2115 flip without it).

urbanNonSmokingManRaiser.why: It acts on every non-smoking urban man (3.54 logits) and the typical one drops from 96% to 40% without it; its other activity is small and disclosed with counts.

nonSmokingManLowerer.why: It lowers risk for non-smoking men, strongly for rural ones where it cancels fewFlagsRaiser, and is the most important part by ablation (AUC 0.707 without it).
